    "Difficulty seeing overall project progress in real-time",

  "overall_experience": "The Clinical Research Coordinator likely found Basecamp to be a straightforward tool for managing daily tasks and collaborating with team members due to its intuitive design. However, the lack of robust real-time project progress visibility and potentially complex navigation when handling multiple research studies might have been a source of frustration.
